title: Lively Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting vegan stew made with lentils, perfect for a chilly evening. This recipe is easy to make and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, carrot, and celery. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add lentils, tomato, vegetable broth, and thyme. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
